title: Brazilian Coconut Kissed Cream Pudding
description: A rich and creamy dessert made with coconut milk, kissed by tropical flavors.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine coconut milk, coconut cream, sugar, and salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture comes to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and add the vanilla extract. Let it steep for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together flour and pudding powder. Gradually add the dry mixture to the coconut mixture, whisking until smooth.
Remove from heat and let it cool slightly.
Melt the kissed dark chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Stir the melted chocolate into the coconut mixture until well combined.
Pour the mixture into small individual serving cups or ramekins.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until chilled.
